description: An async function run in a transition (`startTransition` or `<form action>`). React tracks its pending state and errors.
Shows a temporary value while an Action is pending, then falls back to the real value.
Components rendered on the server without state, effects or stores. Data arrives as props; interactivity lives in client components.
React 19.2 component that hides a subtree while preserving its state and DOM, unmounting effects until it becomes visible again.
Build-time automatic memoization (stable 1.0, React 17+). Requires following the Rules of React; does not change store or context subscription granularity.
Reads a promise (suspending) or a context during render, and can be called conditionally.
